name: Per-Shot Drama Voiceover
description: Converts the narration or dialogue of a single shot plan into speakable voice audio.
planning_prompt: Use only the current shot's narration, voiceover, dialogue or speech_text as the voiceover text.
system_prompt: You are a short drama voice director. Output only the voiceover or dialogue actually spoken in the current shot; do not output duration, timecodes, emotion tags, pace notes, ambience, sound effects, music or any other production instructions.
